pr_title: [Merged by Bors] - disable window pre creation for ios
pr_body:
# Objective

Fixes #5882 

## Solution

Per https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/issues/1705, the root cause is "UIWindow should be created inside UIApplicationMain". Currently, there are two places to create UIWindow, one is Plugin's build function, which is not inside UIApplicationMain. Just comment it out, and it works.
pr_comments: Tested on macos, it works without window early creation.

issue_context.title: Bevy game crashed on ios if swipe from screen bottom up
issue_context.body:
I've met a reproducible crash on bevy ios game. After some trouble shooting, it seems the root cause is, window is not created inside UIApplicationMain. For more info, refer to https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/issues/1705#issuecomment-1236363196, [madsmtm](https://github.com/madsmtm) mentioned that the window should created in StartEvent(Init) handler.

In bevy_winit code, window is created early, any idea why? Is it possible to move this code to StartEvent(Init)?


https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/76ae6f4c6e77866104229659a211045748cfb4bf/crates/bevy_winit/src/lib.rs#L58
comments:
> In bevy_winit code, window is created early, any idea why?

See the comment above that line:

> Note that we create a window here "early" because WASM/WebGL requires the window to exist prior to initializing the renderer.
@bjorn3 yea, I saw it. But not sure is it a hard requirement, any other way to solve the WebGL requirement?
I think it is a hard requirement for WASM/WebGL as the render context is created by calling a method on the `<canvas>` element of the winit "window".
@bjorn3 Good to know, if this is purely for wasm/webgl, then we can condition compile just for that platform?
I just tried comment that code out, crash gone. 🎉 🎉
You could change the line above from `#[cfg(not(target_os = "android"))]` to `#[cfg(not(any(target_os = "android", target_os = "ios")))]`.

review_comments: Would it make sense, rather than excluding platforms where it crashes, to only enable it on platforms where it's mandatory (so wasm)?

So is the actual problem here that window creation _could_ be a startup system on all platforms except wasm? And that late-init of rendering is the actual solution to this?

In which your suggestion makes complete sense, I'm just trying to understand the broader picture of the problem :)

I'd prefer to exclude platforms where it is problematic, and it should include macos too. 
Maybe the line is introduced only for wasm/webgl, but its side effect is unknown for other platforms, and I can't test that, since I don't have windows/linux boxes.
I'll update the pr to exclude macos too and test it.
